decision: user, 2026-09-06 -- freeze the classifier definition, classify, audit, freeze node_kind, THEN render, THEN measure the gold gate
honesty_note_about_what_freezing_means_h: The structural classifier was already executed once during the 2026-09-05 pipeline audit, so its OUTPUT COUNTS are already known (967,122 mediators, etc.). Freezing therefore cannot mean 'blind to the result'. It means exactly what the user asked for: TAU_LOW and TAU_HIGH are inherited UNCHANGED from that pre-commitment and are not touched now or after CVT counts and gold coverage are seen. Any later change to either threshold must be recorded as a NEW rule_version with the reason, never as an edit to this one.

inherited_classifier.why_the_thresholds_are_safe: Measured bimodality: 3,087 of 3,119 Freebase types (98.97%) sit below 0.01 or above 0.9, leaving 32 types in the entire middle. A 20x change in TAU_LOW moves NAMELESS_MEDIATOR_MIDS by 0.45% (964,780 at 0.005 -> 969,160 at 0.10). The split is a property of the data, not of the threshold.

pass_1_outgoing.freebase_type: relation_key minus its last dot-segment (people.person.place_of_birth -> people.person)
pass_1_outgoing.rate: named_rate(T) = over DISTINCT (head_node, T) pairs, the fraction whose head node is a HUMAN_READABLE_SURFACE
pass_1_outgoing.node_rule: all out-types mediator-like (rate <= TAU_LOW) -> NAMELESS_MEDIATOR; else any out-type ordinary (rate >= TAU_HIGH) -> NAME_RESOLVABLE; else -> MIXED; no outgoing edges -> UNKNOWN

pass_2_incoming.rate: obj_named_rate(R) = fraction of R's DISTINCT tail endpoints that are HUMAN_READABLE_SURFACE
pass_2_incoming.node_rule: same thresholds over the set of incoming relations

inherited_classifier.merge_rule: final = pass 1 label everywhere it decided; pass 2 label on the pass-1 UNKNOWN set only
inherited_classifier.cross_validation: pass 2 re-labels, from incoming relations only, 1,011,820 bare MIDs pass 1 labelled from outgoing types only -- agreement 95.75%
inherited_classifier.control: of 533,758 endpoints RoG demonstrably named and which have outgoing edges, only 238 (0.045%) are false-positively called mediator-like

surface_class_rules_verbatim.evaluation_order: null -> empty -> MID -> dateish -> numeric -> schema-path -> surface
surface_class_rules_verbatim.note: The rules match on s.strip(), but the STORED source_rog_endpoint stays verbatim. Section 2's lesson: normalization belongs to derived views, never to identity. 49 endpoints carry leading whitespace and keep it.

node_kind_mapping_FROZEN.VALUE_LITERAL: surface class OTHER (null / empty / date / numeric / schema-path string)
node_kind_mapping_FROZEN.CVT_MEDIATOR: bare MID with merged label NAMELESS_MEDIATOR
node_kind_mapping_FROZEN.MID_NAMED_ENTITY: bare MID with merged label NAME_RESOLVABLE
node_kind_mapping_FROZEN.UNRESOLVED_OTHER: bare MID with merged label MIXED or UNKNOWN (no structural signal either direction)

MID_NAMED_ENTITY_SEMANTICS_WARNING.what_it_means: An ordinary (non-mediator) Freebase entity that RoG left as a bare MID. It is an entity that OUGHT to have a Freebase name.
MID_NAMED_ENTITY_SEMANTICS_WARNING.what_it_does_NOT_mean: That we possess that name. We do not, and cannot from the released artifact.
MID_NAMED_ENTITY_SEMANTICS_WARNING.consequence_for_directive_section_13: ORDINARY_ENTITY_UNRESOLVED_N = 0 will NOT be met, and this is stated BEFORE the classifier runs so it cannot read as a post-hoc excuse. The blocker is structural and already measured: entities_names.json names ZERO of the 1,652,622 RoG bare MIDs (NAME_MAPPING_PRESENT_N = 0) and contains no g. entries at all, while ~405,358 bare MIDs are g. ids. Directive section 16 governs: document the upstream surface collapse, do NOT guess MIDs.
MID_NAMED_ENTITY_SEMANTICS_WARNING.required_reporting: ORDINARY_ENTITY_UNRESOLVED_N is reported as a measured number with its cause, never suppressed and never driven to 0 by relabelling ordinary entities as mediators.

fields_written_by_this_pass.node_kind: one of the five values above
fields_written_by_this_pass.classification_score: max named-rate over the out-types (pass 1) or over the in-relations' ranges (pass 2). Mediators sit near 0, ordinary entities above TAU_HIGH. NULL for surface-decided nodes, where no inference was made.
fields_written_by_this_pass.source_mid: the MID for bare-MID nodes; NULL for readable surfaces, where RoG destroyed the MID -- that NULL is the documented upstream loss, not a gap in this pass

fields_deliberately_NOT_written_by_this_.display_name_disambiguated: rendering, user step 5 -- needs the full display_name population before collisions can be computed
fields_deliberately_NOT_written_by_this_.why: The order is classify -> audit -> FREEZE node_kind -> render. Rendering before node_kind is frozen would let text choices feed back into classification.

retrieval_role_POLICY.principle: node_kind = what the graph node IS. retrieval_role = whether/how L1 indexes it. Section 3 does not decide indexing.
retrieval_role_POLICY.note: No retrieval policy is ratified for ANY class, so no class is marked indexed here -- not even READABLE_ENTITY, whose indexing is expected but is not yet the user's ratified decision. The two distinct UNDECIDED values record WHAT each class is waiting on.

GOLD_ONLY_IN_CVT_TEXT_PREREGISTRATION.registered_before: any CVT record text is rendered and before any encoder is run
GOLD_ONLY_IN_CVT_TEXT_PREREGISTRATION.supersedes: the single-number version in NSM_ACQUISITION_PREREGISTRATION.json, which this expands into the 7-way decomposition at two matching strictnesses
GOLD_ONLY_IN_CVT_TEXT_PREREGISTRATION.EXACT: byte-identical containment of the gold string in the rendered text
GOLD_ONLY_IN_CVT_TEXT_PREREGISTRATION.NORMALIZED: Unicode NFC -> casefold -> strip -> collapse internal whitespace, applied identically to both sides, then containment
GOLD_ONLY_IN_CVT_TEXT_PREREGISTRATION.threshold_deliberately_not_pinned: The distribution is unmeasured, so pinning a pass/fail cut now would be inventing a number. What IS pinned is the metric definition, which is where the hidden knob would otherwise live.
GOLD_ONLY_IN_CVT_TEXT_PREREGISTRATION.decision_this_gates: whether CVT nodes get Dense/SPLADE encoding at all

hard_rules_carried_forward: Do NOT special-case node ids. Any fix must be a general deterministic source-level rule.
Never expose a MID as a semantic representation (directive section 13, MID_VISIBLE_AS_DISPLAY_N = 0).
Do NOT merge nodes because names match (directive section 8).
CVTs get deterministic structural labels from incident schema, never a fake neighbour name (directive section 6).
The NSM projection diagnostic is evidence, NOT a recipe; it must not modify V1 identities.

CORRECTIONS_TO_RATIONALE_TEXT.what_was_claimed: That the NAME_RESOLVABLE band is 'overwhelmingly g. machine ids'. This assistant repeated that gloss from the 2026-09-05 pipeline audit into the section 3 freeze document and the classification audit.
CORRECTIONS_TO_RATIONALE_TEXT.diagnosis: The prior audit's sentence was about the LEAVES it was discussing, where it is correct at 97.3%. Generalising it to the whole band was this assistant's error. The band is 76.5% m., and it splits perfectly by classification pass.
CORRECTIONS_TO_RATIONALE_TEXT.why_the_split_is_perfect: Not one of the 405,358 g. MIDs in the released RoG graph has an outgoing edge -- 0.00%, against 81.50% of m. MIDs. So pass 1, which reads outgoing types, can never see a g. node, and every g. node is necessarily decided by pass 2.

STRUCTURAL_FACT_g_MIDS_HAVE_NO_OUT_EDGES.status: MEASURED on the released RoG v1 tables
STRUCTURAL_FACT_g_MIDS_HAVE_NO_OUT_EDGES.interpretation: UNKNOWN which of two causes this is, and the released graph cannot separate them: (a) a genuine property of Freebase g. objects, which are late-added and may only ever appear as targets; or (b) an artefact of RoG's extraction, which may only have expanded outward from m. seeds. A boundary/cap effect is a poor fit because it would truncate BOTH prefixes, and m. sits at 81.5% while g. is exactly 0.
STRUCTURAL_FACT_g_MIDS_HAVE_NO_OUT_EDGES.consequence: All g. classification rests entirely on incoming-relation range evidence. The pass-1/pass-2 cross-validation agreement of 95.75% therefore says nothing about g. nodes -- there is no second signal for them.

CORRECTIONS_TO_RATIONALE_TEXT.why_it_matters_for_section_13: It splits ORDINARY_ENTITY_UNRESOLVED_N = 62,375 into two populations with DIFFERENT causes, which the single 'no g. entries' explanation wrongly merged: 14,636 g. nodes that entities_names.json structurally cannot name (it holds no g. keys at all), and 47,739 m. nodes it could hold and simply does not. The second group is the file's incompleteness, not a structural barrier -- so a more complete m. naming source would reduce, though not close, the section 13 gap.
CORRECTIONS_TO_RATIONALE_TEXT.classifier_unaffected: This corrects RATIONALE TEXT only. No threshold, rule, mapping or label changed; NODE_KIND_HASH is unchanged.

_correction_policy: Corrections are APPENDED, never applied by editing the original text. The superseded wording stays visible so the record shows what was believed when the rule was frozen.

RETRIEVAL_ROLE_RESOLVED_2026_09_06.resolution: ALL_NODE. Every canonical node is RETRIEVAL_ELIGIBLE.
RETRIEVAL_ROLE_RESOLVED_2026_09_06.supersedes_in_this_document: retrieval_role_POLICY, which routed CVT_MEDIATOR to UNDECIDED_PENDING_CVT_GOLD_GATE and every other kind to UNDECIDED_PENDING_RETRIEVAL_POLICY. Both are now RETRIEVAL_ELIGIBLE. The separation this document insisted on -- node_kind is what the node IS, retrieval_role is how L1 treats it -- is unchanged and is what made the reversal cheap: no graph semantics moved.
